item.title: 【General Music Discussion】How to download vimeo original/source video?
item.description: Hi, I've recently run into some problems. I heard there's a script that can extract and download Vimeo's original source videos, even when the videos aren't publicly available, bypassing restrictions and downloading them. But when I asked an AI to help me, it couldn't do it. Clever netizens, do you know how? Could you teach me?
item.author: fansai_66666
